en-US.name: Foul Mouth
en-US.summary: Alexa with attitude. NSFW one-liners on demand.
en-US.description:
A novelty skill that responds with off-color one-liners. Say 'Alexa, open foul mouth' then 'swear at me' for a quick burn.

Note: contains profanity. Intended for personal use or submission under a Mature content rating.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask foul mouth to swear at me
Alexa, tell foul mouth to go off

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill, then say 'swear at me'. The skill should reply with one of three rotating responses. Profanity is intentional.
